title: Author extraction manually decodes only a subset of valid XML text
reasoning: Core properties are XML, but extractAuthor uses exact-tag regexes and hand-decodes only five named entities. Valid author names containing numeric character references such as René or elements with harmless attributes such as cp:lastModifiedBy xml:space="preserve" are returned incorrectly or missed entirely, causing wrong version attribution.
recommendation: Parse docProps/core.xml with the same XML parser used by the adapters, extract lastModifiedBy/creator by local name or namespace-aware lookup, and let the XML parser decode text content instead of maintaining manual entity replacement logic.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: metadata.test.ts covers only plain exact cp/dc tags and a named & entity, not numeric character references, attributes on metadata elements, or alternate namespace prefixes.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add metadata tests for `<cp:lastModifiedBy>René Descartes</cp:lastModifiedBy>`, `<cp:lastModifiedBy>René</cp:lastModifiedBy>`, and `<cp:lastModifiedBy xml:space="preserve">Marie Dupont</cp:lastModifiedBy>` and assert the decoded author is returned.
minimumFixScope: Replace the regex/manual entity handling in packages/core/src/adapters/metadata.ts and expand packages/core/test/metadata.test.ts.
